hypothesis: Candidate V2's dilution-compensated ranking objective may need one additional pass over the fixed Train rows to improve SELECTED-over-PLAUSIBLE margins. A fresh two-epoch run from the unchanged base checkpoint tests optimization time without changing data, loss balance, model scope, threshold, or selection gates.

protocolVerification.basis: V3 is a newly authorized candidate initialized from the unchanged base checkpoint, not a continuation of V2. Epoch 1 is diagnostic only; epoch 2 is the sole selectable checkpoint. The threshold and all nine Dev gates remain frozen.
protocolVerification.devUse: epoch-wise diagnosis and final epoch-2 decision under unchanged gates

finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: evaluate both epochs for diagnosis; save and select epoch 2 only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: exactly two epochs; epoch 2 final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run

expectedMeasurableEffect.primary: epoch 2 P0 raw-ranking Macro and selected-above-plausible rate exceed epoch 1/V2
expectedMeasurableEffect.secondary: epoch 2 P0 directional Macro exceeds epoch 1/V2 without exceeding the unchanged FP guard
expectedMeasurableEffect.failureCondition: absolute scores rise while relational metrics remain flat or regress
